title: Everyday Phrases — Fixing the Home Printer
scene_zh: 修印表機 · 情境對話
title_quote: Our flight leaves at six ten tomorrow.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🖨 實用「修印表機」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Fixing the Home Printer
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「修印表機」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是出發前一晚的書桌：隔天六點十分的飛機、兩張登機證還沒印、電腦清單裡找不到印表機、換一個新的墨水匣、紙卡在滾軸深處拉不出來、雙面設定印反了、改用傳輸線直接連、叫孩子過來看螢幕上的錯誤代碼，最後終於印好，摺進藍色資料夾。整部影片共 800 句、400 組對話循環，用字與句式都落在 CEFR A2，不必查文法、不必背單字，躺下來播放就好。聽的節奏：先聽男聲正常語速，接著女聲放慢一次，最後兩人連貫來回，一段接一段循環到睡著。明天你真的要印東西時，這些句子會自己跑出來。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Fixing the Home Printer' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is the desk the night before a trip: a six ten flight, two boarding passes still unprinted, the printer missing from the computer list, a fresh ink cartridge, a sheet stuck deep in the roller, the duplex option set the wrong way round, a cable tried instead of the wireless box, a child reading the error code on the small screen, and at last two clean passes folded into the blue folder. 800 lines, 400 pairs, all wording at CEFR A2, so you can play it and drift off without following every rule. Repeat after each voice if you feel awake: normal speed first, slow second, then both speakers together. #EnglishListening #SleepEnglish #LearnEnglish

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our flight leaves at six ten tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊər flaɪt livz æt sɪks tɛn təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們明天的飛機六點十分就要飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we need both boarding passes tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi nid boʊθ ˈbɔrdɪŋ ˈpæsɪz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們今晚得把兩張登機證印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you open the laptop for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈoʊpən ðə ˈlæpˌtɑp fɔr mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is right there on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz raɪt ðɛr ɑn ðə dɛsk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 按一下這個鍵，看，亮了沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I forget it twice a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the sticky note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, the message from the airline.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ frʌm ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，航空公司傳來的訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It arrived last night after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both carry our names on top.
dialogue.zh: 兩張最上面都是我們的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the seat numbers there too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box for the gate is blank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɑks fɔr ðə ɡeɪt ɪz blæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 登機口那一格還是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They announce that at the airport.
dialogue.zh: 那個要到機場才會公佈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will print the first one.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ wɪl prɪnt ðə fɜrst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好，我先把第一張印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the printer in this room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們把它收到哪裡去了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the desk, by the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It wears a coat of dust.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the cord still plugged in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the wall socket is empty.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，牆上的插座是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the loose end, feel it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə lus ɛnd fil ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it in all the way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing yet on the small screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the button on the side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That means it is waking up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me pull the tray out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fetch the rest from the shelf.
dialogue.zh: 去架子上把剩下的拿下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 就一般的白紙，不用漂亮的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift it a bit, then push.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we can print right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I am on the ticket page.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ æm ɑn ðə ˈtɪkɪt peɪdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks which printer to use.
dialogue.zh: 它問要用哪一台印表機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see only the old fax machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ˈoʊnli ði oʊld fæks məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 我只看到那台舊傳真機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gone, it should be listed here.
dialogue.zh: 真的，它本來該列在這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wake it from the box itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn weɪk ɪt frʌm ðə bɑks ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 那就直接從機器上叫它醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The laptop makes a soft sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long before the taxi comes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 如果沒停，就按停止兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the whole machine went quiet.
dialogue.zh: 現在整台機器突然沒聲音了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on the note pad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One one seven, then a dot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, the code is clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we can search it later.
dialogue.zh: 好，待會兒可以查這個代號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the machine is right here.
dialogue.zh: 可是機器就在我們腳邊啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 也許那條看不見的線睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The signal gets weak down here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的 wifi 機在樓上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 所以這兩張票只好先等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top row, next to the gear.
dialogue.zh: 最上面一列，齒輪圖案旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gear, yes, I see it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it and look for network.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 未連線，一個好長的單字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 格子滿的有時候也會騙人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I add it by hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a button for that.
dialogue.zh: 有個按鈕就是做這個的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it searches the whole house.
dialogue.zh: 現在它在搜尋整棟房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it look for a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It only means it still works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, all the way to ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu ɔl ðə weɪ tə tɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The router needs the same trick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You mean the box with lights?
dialogue.zh: 你是說那台會發燈的盒子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one, upstairs by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not touch the phone line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它上面的燈一顆顆亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在再看一下你的筆電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 清單上還是沒有印表機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you pick the wrong network?
dialogue.zh: 你該不會選到別的網路吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有兩個網路共用同一個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The password sits under the router.
dialogue.zh: 密碼就印在數據機下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type them in the white box.
dialogue.zh: 把它們打進那個白框裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, but greyed out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That list holds two old jobs.
dialogue.zh: 清單裡還留著兩筆舊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits for the dead machine.
dialogue.zh: 它在等那台沒反應的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and it says ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find that choice?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me print a test page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the menu, not the ticket?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那張簡單的白頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear it start to pull.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the text is there, but pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə tɛkst ɪz ðɛr bʌt peɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 淡淡的線代表墨水快沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們知道是哪種顏色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This drawer holds batteries and tape.
dialogue.zh: 這抽屜裡只有電池和膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可是膠帶又不能當墨水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 但至少我們找到印表機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ink is the other half.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the tickets in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 登機證留到早上一併印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or now, if we are quick.
dialogue.zh: 或是現在就印，如果我們快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen says the ink is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin sɛz ði ɪŋk ɪz ˈɛmpi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 黑色，又是那個字母 B。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go look in the hall closet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not grab the wrong one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it back on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那盒標著 B，就是黑色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it over, read the number.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more box, on the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好，墨水碰到外面乾得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lay a cloth on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, how do I open it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little door is at the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl dɔr ɪz æt ðə frʌnt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The holder slid to the middle.
dialogue.zh: 墨水匣架自己滑到中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is where the ink sits.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上面，靠近 B 那個記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One drop fell on the wood.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not open the new one yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt ˈoʊpən ðə nju wʌn jɛt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does this old one go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tear the foil from the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看到那條黃色膠帶了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pull it, the whole strip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pulls ink through the head.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a chart of squares.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這塊黑色看起來薄薄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print the page one more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much was this small box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一個墨水匣就要二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it back in the closet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me run one dark page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half of it is still inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not pull yet, look first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the corner sits deep inside.
dialogue.zh: 你看，紙角卡在很深的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me shine the light in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我看到一個白白的紙邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small panel at the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the way the paper goes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A piece came off in my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pis keɪm ɔf ɪn maɪ hænd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a scrap is still in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the drawer with the tape.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found them, the tips are clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I reach past the gray roller.
dialogue.zh: 我的手伸過那根灰色滾軸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The scrap rests under the wheel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 滾輪看起來磨得扁扁的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them with a dry cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I turn the wheel by hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɜrn ðə wil baɪ hænd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wheel is hard to turn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper in the tray is wrinkled.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the tray slides in now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒有卡的聲音，只有嗡嗡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 先印一張普通的空白頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 它吸紙了，出來一張很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I open it once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, I will bring the cups.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這台機器聞起來暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 溫溫的墨水味，沒有不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the guide to the edge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那嗡嗡聲聽起來像音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the back is upside down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I cannot read the small print.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I pick the wrong box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩個選項長得一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long edge is the normal one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That turns the back page over.
dialogue.zh: 那個設定會把背面翻過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sucks the page back in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the small print.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的意思是每一頁都要印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type all in that small box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the shiny side faced down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每一張都要照同一個方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the edge ate my barcode.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðə ɛdʒ et maɪ ˈbɑrˌkoʊd/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，邊框把條碼吃掉了一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box says the smaller size.
dialogue.zh: 設定裡選的是較小的那個尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在邊邊不會被切掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print it before tea gets cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Front and back on one sheet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 連背面摸起來都還溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold it wet and it cracks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your pass has a gray mark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The print head needs a clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The menu has a cleaning mode.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個清潔程序很吃墨水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out comes a bar of colors.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We still need the hotel page.
dialogue.zh: 飯店那張確認單也要印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可是這條無線上傳一直斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have the old cable?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stɪl hæv ði oʊld ˈkeɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我們還有那條舊傳輸線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It lived in the tool bag.
dialogue.zh: 那條線以前放在工具袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看看大衣下面那個紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The other is flat and thin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this goes to the machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在有兩個名字，都是我們的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 它顯示已連線，沒有用 wifi。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Test it with the hotel page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 比剛剛無線的時候快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在另一個名字睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it there, do not erase.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But this wire runs across the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðɪs waɪər rʌnz əˈkrɔs ðə flɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape it flat on the floor.
dialogue.zh: 用膠帶把線固定在地板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好多了，沒有鬆鬆的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A loop pulls the plug out.
dialogue.zh: 繞一圈就會把插頭拉開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take the other chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在重印那兩張登機證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這樣平順的嗡嗡聲讓人安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hums all the way through.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The two sided box fooled us.
dialogue.zh: 那個雙面選項把我們騙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least the printer is still lit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət list ðə ˈprɪntər ɪz stɪl lɪt/
dialogue.zh: 起碼印表機的燈還亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘了，一張紙都沒動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們是不是把它弄壞了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the little screen is odd.
dialogue.zh: 可是機器那塊小螢幕怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set three, a friend may come.
dialogue.zh: 擺三個吧，也許有朋友來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他們都看得懂那個螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says down in a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他那一分鐘從來不止一分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clear a space on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the machine sits quiet again.
dialogue.zh: 現在機器又安靜下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們輸給這台印表機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 紙和墨水都查過了，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you watch the small screen?
dialogue.zh: 那你們看機器上的小螢幕了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 只有兩條黑線，別的都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a code, let me see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə koʊd lɛt mi si/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上面有一個小小的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你以前修過一樣的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At school, on their big one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I learned it from her, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 不過那個雙面印還有問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain side up, same as before.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my name is cut off.
dialogue.zh: 可是我的名字被切掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 選那個配合整頁的項目。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two sheets, done in a second.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with a cup of tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the tea is still warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們剛剛清過一次噴頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hotel page shows a code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They need that at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我手機也找到印表機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A line came out, no wire!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把步驟寫下來給明天用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All of it, in three words.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Corner only, keep the light free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lay them flat, do not stack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check your name, is it right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same as the passport, letter by letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm æz ðə ˈpæspərt ˈlɛtər baɪ ˈlɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 跟護照上一模一樣，一個字母一個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那跟你的護照對得上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get my passport from the drawer.
dialogue.zh: 從抽屜把我的護照拿來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 最上面那個抽屜，地圖旁邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they go in the folder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個有分頁標籤的藍文件夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make one copy for the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sign the back of your pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think the printer has done enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðə ˈprɪntər hæz dʌn ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 我想印表機已經夠累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it off at the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, we may print more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the cloth from the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The steps stay on the printer.
dialogue.zh: 步驟貼就留在印表機上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the folder on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 哪個鑰匙，車的還是家的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩把都掛在同一個圈上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the suitcases wait by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə ˈsutˌkeɪsɪz weɪt baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 你看，行李箱在門邊等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 兩個把手都掛上行李牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這間房聞起來讓人想睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 看看那一疊整整齊齊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們三個人，一台印表機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our son did the last bit.
dialogue.zh: 最後那一段是我們兒子做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那台印表機現在認識我們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 文件夾、登機證、護照都齊了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 離計程車還有四個小時。
